scope: Small feasibility and directional forecast pilot; not a promotion-quality whole-season test
selection: Target GW22-25, earliest source publication first, source-linked unique player-fixture evidence. Aim 40 cases, hard maximum 50. Select by pre-match text categories and identity only, never realized starts or forecast errors. If source coverage is insufficient, report it rather than fill with current text or FPL availability-only evidence.
categories: positive praise or proposed selection without start guarantee
timing: Article publication and modification must precede target cutoff; require independently archived predeadline body for a certified historical test. Today-fetched historical articles are retrospective feasibility evidence only, with no certified before-deadline performance claim. No future fixture labels in selection.
candidate: Fixed conservative diagnostic intervention, no fitted weights: explicit unavailable p_start and cameo zero; explicit not-ready-for-90 preserves p_start and only excludes 90 from conditional duration if a valid common timeline replay exists. Soft positive role/ready-for-selection/praise alone receives no automatic p boost. Soft narrative candidate may be assessed separately only with preregistered numeric mapping and certified source vintages; never invent a p from prose.
comparison: Same frozen B predictions/player-fixtures; start Brier, log loss, minute MAE and bias where candidate is mathematically defined. Full role/physical MM-PM replay required before any xP claim. Report extractor classification validity separately from forecast value. No generalization from an enriched 30-50-case sample.
fallback: If predeadline body archive cannot be established, lock and describe retrospective cases, do not score them as a leakage-safe candidate comparison. Provide prospectively timestamped current evidence and a usable source-attributed explanatory player panel with no forecast rewrite.
app: Existing B desktop layout only. Explanation/fact/source/age/scope distinctions; no unsupported reasons or probabilities; missing evidence remains unknown. Production and actual squad unchanged.
